gates.description: No single points of failure on critical paths — every critical link must have a redundant path
Firewall policy must be default deny with explicit allow rules — no allow-all rules
TLS 1.2+ required — modern cipher suites only, certificates with monitoring for expiration
Network configuration must be version-controlled as code — no manual CLI-only changes
Bandwidth, latency, packet loss, and error rate monitoring must be configured with baselines
Every network change must have a rollback plan documented before the change is applied

anti_patterns.description: All servers on the same network segment — no segmentation, no isolation, compromised server reaches everything
Hundreds of rules accumulated over years — nobody knows which are still needed, allow-all rules buried in the middle
DNS configured once, never maintained — stale records pointing to decommissioned servers, TTL set to 24 hours for everything
Network devices configured manually via CLI — no version control, no consistency, configuration drift between devices
Latency is high but nobody can explain why — no baseline measurements, no path analysis, vague complaint

escalation_triggers: DDoS attack in progress exceeding mitigation capacity
BGP hijacking or route leak detected
Security breach: unauthorized network access or lateral movement detected
ISP/provider issue affecting connectivity with no ETA for resolution
Network capacity approaching limits with no expansion path

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with network topology requirements and security policies

output_certifications: No single points of failure on critical network paths
Firewall policy is default deny with explicit allow rules and business justification
TLS 1.2+ with modern cipher suites and certificate expiration monitoring
Monitoring configured with baselines for bandwidth, latency, packet loss, error rates
Rollback plan documented for every network change
